test_item:
When "Install" option is true in
(Install is true and SAMType is not Logging; AuthData is copied to the secure storage)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData package with Install true and a non-Logging SAMType + trigger
2. Confirm the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
er:
1. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData package with Install true and a non-Logging SAMType + trigger
2. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the copied AuthData
